title: 'To my fellow education professionals, this book is PURE GOLD'
summary: Talbot runs the body that accredits schools across the Middle States region. He reads it as a book about stewarding an institution's future, and recommends it to boards outside business entirely.
attribution_title: President and CEO, Middle States Association
blockquote: I don't know Eric Ries (though I wish I did!) and I have no stake in the success of his book, but I cannot recommend it highly enough for anyone who cares about governance.
